_comment: READ-ONLY leg profile. R61: read-only was an INSTRUCTION and six violations were observed; this file is the enforcement. R129: the fence was also INCOHERENT - it permitted writing harness/notes/** and denied git commit, so a read-only leg could produce a durable artifact and could not preserve it. That destroyed three receipts when their worktrees were pruned (R128) and nearly took I0's scout the same way. The permission to WRITE a path and to COMMIT that path are the same permission; splitting them produces work that exists and cannot be kept. Scoped git add + commit are now allowed. push, merge, checkout and reset stay denied - those are what read-only was ever protecting, and Gate C's pre-push hook remains the real boundary. BP4 2026-09-03 (capsule 09-03 hardening item): the blanket deny lines for git commit / git add contradicted the scoped allow above - deny wins in Claude Code, so Haiku legs stopped at the fence in BP3. Removed; the scoped allow stands; push/merge/checkout/reset stay denied. `git branch --merged` allowed for the worktree census. Legs use `cd <path> && git status`, never `git -C` (unmatched by the allow patterns).
